This stakeholder survey will gather insights on the use of AI in healthcare and pharmaceuticals, focusing on the benefits, enabling factors and barriers to adoption.
The Commission seeks feedback from stakeholders with relevant experience and expertise on its draft guidelines on trusted flaggers.
The European Commission launched a dedicated open consultation to help shaping future EuroQCI activities to be supported from 2027 onwards.
This consultation aims to collect feedback on the clarity of the guidelines and usefulness of the examples.
The European Commission has launched a call for evidence to gather feedback on possible targeted measures to adjust the EU copyright framework.
This targeted survey aims to capture real-world experience of accessing and reusing health data - and complying with EU rules when bringing data-driven digital health technologies to market.
The Commission is consulting third parties on the draft measures that Alphabet must implement to ensure effective interoperability with AI services on its Android operating system (Google Android), as required by Article 6(7) of the DMA.
The Commission is consulting third parties on the proposed measures that Alphabet must implement to ensure effective sharing of Google Search data with third party undertakings providing online search engines, as required by Article 6(11) of the Digital Markets Act (“DMA”).
Part of a broader study, this survey seeks stakeholder input about energy consumption and energy efficiency of AI models and AI systems.
